text.tspan: Gerbil / Gambit process
Produce semantic export + target/runtime requirements
Own and reap its direct executor child
Inert request / immutable input references
No Scheme heap address or MLIR handle
Semantic version + approved lowering policy
Zig executor process
Resolve recipe, capabilities, budgets and owned outputs
Own and reap native tool / service children
Do not compete inside Gambit with its waitpid(-1) handler
MLIR service child process
Own contexts, operations, dialects, passes and LLVM emission
Pinned C++ / native build; optional C API inside service
Verifier / diagnostic / crash reproducer support
Completed output role
C-ABI companion OR full Gambit protocol code object
Exact export / pipeline / target / dependency identities
Unsupported / failure / cancellation request
Retain diagnostics; do not publish success
Cancellation completion requires actual child/resource settlement
Executor validates and publishes native product
No semantic instance or initializer result cached
Gambit receives real executor terminal status
Gambit consumes the result
Preflight before mapping; original link/setup/init authority
Runtime objects, GC, control and unload remain Gambit-owned
Compiler-process isolation is not an OS security sandbox.
This design does not repair existing runtime GC/SMP or Darwin loader faults.
Process budgets, descendant cancellation and source/control correspondence still require qualification.
